items.description: # 30 Minutes to RescueA Mars colony is on the brink of collapse.A massive dust storm disables critical systems across the station. Oxygen levels are dropping. The reactor is unstable. People are panicking.You have **30 minutes** to stop the disaster.Every decision may save the colony… or trigger a chain reaction that destroys it.---## Manage critical resourcesBalance the survival of the station through key resources:• Oxygen • Water • Energy • Food • ColonistsOne wrong decision can doom the entire colony.---## Make rapid decisionsEvents escalate quickly:• oxygen leaks • reactor overheating • corridor fires • airlock failures • riots and panicSometimes you have time to think. Sometimes you have only seconds.---## Chain reaction systemEvery decision has consequences.Seal a sector — lose people. Cut power — lose the greenhouse. Stabilize the reactor — but sacrifice the medbay.A single mistake can cascade across the station.---## Atmospheric sci-fi settingExplore the tense environment of a Mars colony:• command center • research labs • living quarters • reactor core • greenhouses • raging storm outsideEvery location is part of the fight for survival.---## Multiple endingsWill you save the colony?Or will the storm bury it beneath Martian dust?The outcome depends entirely on your choices. items.description: A cozy retail sim that was definitely not assembled the night before launch.Run your very own corner store! Stock the shelves, ring up customers, set your prices, and slowly come to terms with the fact that something is deeply, spiritually wrong with this building.The cola costs whatever it feels like. The empty boxes have opinions about where they want to be thrown. Customers pay by card because they are, frankly, too afraid to handle cash here. And the soundtrack? That's coming from a cassette the tape deck is currently eating, and no, you cannot turn it off, and no, we don't know whose voice that is.Features:🛒 Actual shopkeeping! Probably!📦 Physics that range from "fine" to "war crime"💸 A pricing system you control with your bare hands and zero guidance📼 An original Dreamcast-era soundtrack, lovingly run through a haunted cassette🐛 Bugs we have reclassified as "emergent atmosphere"👻 At least one (1) ghost. We think. Reports vary.It's not broken. It's brave. Wishlist now before it becomes self-aware. items.description: About this game After the first station is where the protagonist can embark on a peaceful voyage through a wonderful and magical environment. It’s we who decide our own life. So cheer up, everything will work out in the end. 🚂 • • • • • • • • Life is like a train embarking on a journey，there will be an ending towards the journey. However, it doesn’t matter, what matters the most is the things you went through, every tiny little precious memory accumulated can make your life whole. Every different station narrates about different stages of life.KEY FEATURES• After the first station is developed by a one-man team. • First-Person Gameplay• Atmospheric and appealing graphics• Light Puzzles• Amazing and magical landscape to explore You can disable the effects (Bloom, Motion Blur, Ambient Occlusion) in the setting. It would be highly recommended to enable the settings to enhance the game experience. However, It will slow down the fps at the same time. It's best only when it fits your computer graphics setting. items.description: Welcome to the head of the most monstrous industry !You’ve just been promoted to CEO of a rather unusual factory: your workers are monsters, your machines are hungry for ore, and your currency of choice is called Monstercoins. With Elias, your ever-enthusiastic (and sarcastic) right-hand man, you’ll turn a pile of dusty scrap metal into an unshakable industrial empire.Your mission ? Produce, optimize, and innovate… while surviving the unexpected.🚀 An empire that starts small… and grows colossalYou begin with a handful of underpaid monsters and one squeaky machine. But with a bit of flair (and a lot of Monstercoins), everything can change :Recruit and train your monsters : each comes with their own strengths, moods, and productivity. It’s up to you to put them in the right role.Build and upgrade your machines : every upgrade makes the factory rumble and multiplies your profits.Automate your production chain : watch ores turn into ingots, then finished products—almost without lifting a finger.🧠 Elias, your right-hand man (and reluctant tutor)Elias is with you from day one: he explains, he grumbles, he jokes… but he’s indispensable. The true memory of the company, he’ll teach you how to survive in this joyful industrial chaos.⚙️ Management, setbacks, and decisionsIndustry is never smooth sailing…Positive events can boost your production or reveal unique opportunities.But beware of breakdowns, sabotage, or price spikes that can throw your plans into disarray.React quickly, adjust your choices, and turn every problem into an opportunity.🔬 Research & Development: expand your empireThanks to R&D, your factory is constantly evolving :Unlock brand-new machines and technologies.Expand your production floor to host more and more lines.Discover unique synergies to dominate the market.💰 Monstercoins: the lifeblood of your companyEvery product, every upgrade, every decision is paid for, and rewarded, with Monstercoins. Hoarding this currency isn’t just about profit : it’s a philosophy. The more your conveyors run, the more your empire sparkles.Master the financial markets and use your influence to boost profits.Complete delivery missions for prestigious clients to earn a rewarding bonus.🌍 A living world around your factoryYour factory isn’t alone in the void :Passersby roam the streets, bringing life to your industrial district.A day/night cycle transforms the atmosphere and lights up the factory in new ways.Zoom in and you’ll hear machines pounding in immersive 3D audio, even though the game is in 2D.🎵 An atmosphere you can hear as much as you can playEven in 2D, your factory sounds like a living world :The rumble of machines,The clattering of conveyors,The sighs of your monster workers…Everything contributes to the immersion of a unique industrial universe.⚡ In short, Idle Tycoon Manufacturing is…A quirky industrial management game where your workers are monsters.Machines to build, upgrade, and automate.A system of positive and negative events that shake up your plans.A complete R&D system to grow and diversify your factory.A living, immersive world.Playable solo or with friends.And above all… tons of Monstercoins raining down!
